messages:
Maya Chen: @here PagerBot opened incident INC-2026-0423 — spike in inference latency impacting eu-west-1. War room: https://warroom.redwood.example/INC-2026-0423
PagerBot: Severity: S1 (production). Pager policy fired: oncall paged. Observed: p99 gen latency ~3.2s (baseline ~600ms). Error rate up 4.8%.
Henry Ortiz: I'm heading into the war room now. Standing by to own triage.
Maya Chen: Henry — can you confirm you'll be incident owner? Need someone to own customer comms + mitigation decisions.
Henry Ortiz: Confirmed. I'll take ownership. Starting a quick runbook: check autoscaler, routing, and model variants.
Oncall SRE: ack. I'm attached to the war room. First signal — a lot of GPU queueing on dedicated pools, looks like sustained load from a small set of tenants.
Infra Eng: I'm seeing elevated context-switch times on the infer fleet. Suspect packing/bin-packing gone wrong after a recent placement change. Pulling placement logs now.
Maya Chen: For immediate mitigation, can we route a portion of traffic to a lighter variant (quantized) and nudge autoscaler to spin extra nodes? Henry, @Infra Eng please coordinate.
Infra Eng: Initiating routing change: applying canary route 40% -> model v1.2-q8 (quantized). Also bumping min replicas for the affected pool by 2.
Maya Chen: Good. Draft status update for status.redwood.com below — Henry will post once mitigation is verified. Please review: 
```
Incident: Partial latency degradation in eu-west-1
Impact: Some generation requests may see elevated latency or intermittent timeouts.
Status: Mitigating — traffic being routed to fallback model variant and autoscaler adjustments in progress.
ETA: 15-30 minutes.
Next update: every 15 minutes.
```
Henry Ortiz: I'll post that once we confirm the routed traffic is being served at normal latency. Also creating a customer notification template — feedback welcome: 
- Summary: Customers in eu-west-1 may experience increased latency for model generation. We have routed traffic to a fallback model and are scaling capacity.
- Impact: Increased p99 latency and occasional timeouts between 10:02 UTC and ongoing.
- Mitigation: Rolling routing change + autoscaling; monitoring for stability.
- Action for customers: No action required; reach out to support if you see failures.
- ETA for next update: 15 minutes.
Support Rep: I'll gather a list of impacted tenants (dedicated + heavy usage) and DM product/sales for high-touch outreach.
Oncall SRE: Quick telemetry: after routing 40% to v1.2-q8, p50/p90 recovered fast; p99 now trending down from 3.2s -> 1.1s. Error rate cut from 4.8% -> 1.3%.
Maya Chen: Excellent. Henry, please post the status page update now and pin the customer notification draft in the war room.
PagerBot: Incident INC-2026-0423 status set to 'Mitigating'. Owner: Henry Ortiz. War room link posted.
Henry Ortiz: Posted on status.redwood.com and pinned the customer template in the war room. Support, please send initial notices to affected accounts.
Support Rep: Sending now to the impacted account list. Notifying enterprise owners directly as requested.
Maya Chen: Ops — can you confirm whether rollback to pre-placement config is needed or if routing + scaling is sufficient?
Infra Eng: Routing + scaling holding for now. No rollback yet. I'll continue with placement log analysis; will open a follow-up task if placement changes correlate.
Maya Chen: Can we agree on update cadence in this thread? Let's do 15-minute updates until we declare 'Resolved'. Next update @ +15m.
Henry Ortiz: Acknowledged. Monitoring alerts and metrics. Will report at +15m.
Ops Lead: Night shift handoff note — we're handing monitoring to the SRE night team at 19:00 UTC. @Night SRE will own next watch.
Night SRE: Acknowledged. Monitoring dashboards and alert channels set. Will escalate if regressions occur.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Post-mitigations to capture for postmortem: owner (Henry), RCA lead (Infra Eng), support lead (Support Rep). I'll create a skeleton timeline in the war room for follow-up.
Henry Ortiz: Adding immediate action items to the war room: 1) verify sustained p99 < 1.2s for 10m; 2) validate autoscaler metrics; 3) collect placement logs for 10:00-10:12 UTC; 4) prepare customer follow-ups.
Maya Chen: Copy. If anything changes, flag with @here and update the status page.
PagerBot: Updating incident timeline with actions and who/when.
Maya Chen: Heading out to coordinate exec notify if needed. Keep this thread live with any blocker or regression.
Henry Ortiz: Will do. Closing interim note — routing + scaling looks like it bought us time. Continuing monitoring.
